traceability.notes: The story docs/stories/005.0-DEV-ANNOTATION-VALIDATION.story.md describes a dedicated annotation format validation capability for @story and @req. That capability is implemented as the traceability/valid-annotation-format ESLint rule plus its helper modules. The implementation aligns closely with the story’s requirements: it defines clear format rules, validates syntax using configurable regex patterns, supports multiline and flexible comment styles, and produces precise, requirement-tagged error messages. Extensive tests in tests/rules/valid-annotation-format.test.ts are explicitly tied to this story and to each REQ-* identifier, and they all pass in the Jest suite. Additional rule documentation in docs/rules/valid-annotation-format.md provides the specified format examples (valid and invalid). Integration with the rest of the plugin is validated through config/preset tests, and error handling for malformed comments and invalid configuration is covered. Based on this concrete code and passing tests, all acceptance criteria and listed requirements for Story 005.0 are fully implemented.
